acceptance: A layering, marker or type error in changed code fails `make pr-preflight` locally, within the agreed time budget.
context:
Observed in the run-timeout effort (#4435 lint failures).

Owner decision 2026-11-22 (choice dialog): "Up to 60 s more": add lint-imports, lint-markers and ty (changed files) to make pr-preflight; stop and report if the measured addition exceeds 60 s.
description:
## Problem
In the run-timeout batch PR #4435, `make batch-member-check` and `make pr-preflight` both passed, but CI's `lint` job then failed on three guards the local gates do not run: `make lint-imports` (benchbox.utils imported benchbox.core), `make lint-markers` (`@pytest.mark.medium` decorator), and `make typecheck` (an invalid default). Each cost a fix commit, a new head and a fresh CI cycle.

## Change
Run the lint job's cheap guards that apply to changed paths (at least lint-imports, lint-markers, typecheck on changed files) in `make pr-preflight` and therefore in `batch-member-check`, or document why one cannot run locally.

## Decision gates
- `pr-preflight` has a performance budget: measure its duration before and after on a typical change and report it; if a guard adds more than the budget allows or the budget is unknown, STOP and ask the owner.
- No CI check is weakened or skipped; local gates only add.

## Verification rubric
A change that introduces each of the three violations fails `make pr-preflight` locally (shown); the before/after preflight timing is in the pull request; `make pr-preflight` exits 0 on a clean change.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
